verdict.one_liner: Flipkart collects extensive personal and financial data and shares it broadly with affiliates, advertisers, and business partners.
verdict.summary: A major Indian e-commerce app that gathers buying behavior, device info, location, and even government IDs, then shares insights across a wide network of group companies and third parties for advertising and credit services.
verdict.recommendation_reason: The app engages in extensive data sharing and behavioral tracking, collects sensitive documents like PAN and KYC details, and uses financial data for credit profiling. While it offers some opt-out controls, the overall privacy posture is weak for a shopping app.

red.title: Shares data widely with affiliates and advertisers
red.plain_english: Flipkart may share your personal data with group companies, affiliates, business partners, and third-party advertisers. These partners can use your data for their own marketing, product development, and to personalize your experience on their platforms too.

red.title: Collects government IDs and KYC details
red.plain_english: The app asks for sensitive documents like your PAN card, GST number, and government-issued ID for credit checks and KYC verification. This creates a detailed identity profile tied to your shopping activity.

red.title: Tracks your behavior across websites
red.plain_english: Flipkart records the websites you visit before and after using the app, your IP address, and your browsing patterns. They also use third-party advertising companies that may track you across other apps and sites to show personalized ads.

red.title: Shares health data with third-party doctors
red.plain_english: If you buy medicines, Flipkart may share your prescription and health information with third-party teleconsultants and medical practitioners to validate or reissue your prescription.

red.title: Uses payment data for credit profiling
red.plain_english: Your payment details and transaction history may be used to check your eligibility for loans, insurance, and credit products offered by Flipkart's lending partners and affiliates.

green.title: You can opt out of personalized ads
green.plain_english: You can opt out of personalized ad tracking through your device's settings, which limits how third-party advertising companies use your data for targeting.

green.title: Has a dedicated privacy grievance officer
green.plain_english: Flipkart lists a specific grievance officer with a real email address and physical office location, making it easier to raise privacy complaints.

green.title: Sensitive permissions require your consent
green.plain_english: Access to your camera, contacts, location, and photo gallery is only granted if you explicitly give permission, rather than being forced on you automatically.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: Flipkart can access your camera if you allow it, mainly for features like virtual try-on. It is not required for normal shopping.
categories.detail: The policy states that with consent, Flipkart may access your camera to enhance your experience and provide access to products and services. Voice commands and virtual try-and-buy features are mentioned.
categories.policy_excerpt: With your consent, we may have access to your ... camera ... to ... enhance your experience on the Platform and provide you access to the products and services being offered by us.
concerns: Camera access requested for non-core features
Voice data collected through voice commands

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: The app can access your location if you give permission, mainly for delivery recommendations. It is optional.
categories.detail: Location access is requested with user consent to enhance experience and provide access to products and services.
categories.policy_excerpt: With your consent, we may have access to your ... location ... to ... enhance your experience on the Platform.
concerns: Location data may be used for profiling and delivery optimization

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: Flipkart may read your contacts if you allow it. Since the app broadly shares personal data with business partners and affiliates, contact information could end up on company servers.
categories.detail: The policy explicitly mentions access to contacts in your directory with consent. Given the broad data sharing provisions with group companies, affiliates, and third parties, any contacts accessed may be subject to sharing.
categories.policy_excerpt: With your consent, we may have access to your SMS, instant messages, contacts in your directory, location, camera, photo gallery and device information.
concerns: Contacts access is not core to shopping
Broad sharing provisions apply to all personal data
No explicit commitment to not share contacts

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: You may upload files like prescription photos when needed for medicine orders. This is user-initiated and optional.
categories.detail: The app allows uploading prescriptions and accessing the photo gallery with consent for features like virtual try-on or prescription validation.
categories.policy_excerpt: With your consent, we may have access to your ... photo gallery...
concerns: Photo gallery access requested for non-core features
Prescription uploads involve sensitive health documents

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: Flipkart shares your data with a large network of group companies, affiliates, business partners, sellers, and advertisers. Some of this sharing is for marketing and to personalize ads.
categories.detail: The policy permits sharing personal data with Flipkart group companies, affiliates, related companies, business partners, third-parties, sellers, and advertising companies. Insights derived from user behavior may be shared for promotions, advertisements, marketing, and product development. Plus membership benefits require sharing name, email, and phone number with partners like Netflix. In the event of a merger or acquisition, personal data may be sold or shared with the acquiring entity.
categories.policy_excerpt: The insights derived from this analysis may be shared with our group companies, affiliates, related companies, business partners, and third-parties... We and our affiliates will share / sell some or all of your personal data with another business entity should we plan to merge with, or be acquired by that business entity.
concerns: Broad sharing with unspecified third parties
Data may be sold in M&A transactions
Plus benefits require sharing personal info with streaming partners
No clear list of all data recipients

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: Flipkart collects your name, email, phone, address, and sensitive government IDs like PAN and KYC documents. This identity data is linked to your shopping behavior and shared with credit bureaus and lending partners.
categories.detail: Account creation requires standard personal data. For certain services, Flipkart collects PAN, GST number, government-issued ID, and KYC details to check eligibility for insurance, credit, and payment products. This data is shared with credit bureaus, lending partners, and group companies.
categories.policy_excerpt: We may collect personal data (such as email address, delivery address, name, phone number, credit card/debit card and other payment instrument details or medical or health related information) from you when you set up an account or transact with us... we may also request you to provide your PAN, credit information report, GST Number, Government issued ID cards/number and Know-Your-Customer (KYC) details.
concerns: Government ID collection creates high-risk identity profile
Identity data shared with credit bureaus and lending partners
Account data linked to advertising and marketing profiles

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: Flipkart constantly tracks what you browse, buy, and click. They use this behavior profile to show you targeted ads, and third-party ad companies may also track you across other apps and websites.
categories.detail: The app collects and analyzes buying behavior, browsing patterns, preferences, URLs visited before and after the platform, browser information, and IP address. Cookies and third-party advertising companies are used for personalized ads. Google Analytics is used for marketing and analytical purposes. Users can opt out of personalized ad tracking via device settings.
categories.policy_excerpt: We collect and analyse your personal data relating to your buying behavior, browsing patterns, preferences, and other information... The insights derived from this analysis may be shared with our group companies, affiliates, related companies, business partners, and third-parties... for promotions, advertisements and marketing.
concerns: Extensive behavioral profiling for marketing
Third-party ad networks track users across platforms
Cross-site URL tracking
IP address used for demographic profiling

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: Flipkart says its app is only for adults who can legally contract (18+). However, there is no real system to block younger users from signing up.
categories.detail: The policy states the platform is available only to persons who can form a legally binding contract under the Indian Contract Act, 1872, and claims they do not knowingly collect data from children under 18. No technical enforcement mechanism is described.
categories.policy_excerpt: Use of our Platform is available only to persons who can form a legally binding contract under the Indian Contract Act, 1872. We do not knowingly solicit or collect personal data from children under the age of 18 years.
concerns: No enforcement mechanism for age restriction
Shopping app may appeal to teenagers
18-year threshold is higher than typical 13-year COPPA standard but not enforced

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: Flipkart logs your IP address and the websites you visit before and after using the app. They use this to figure out your general location and interests.
categories.detail: The policy records URLs visited before and after the platform, browser information, and IP addresses. The IP address is used to diagnose server problems, identify users, and gather broad demographic information.
categories.policy_excerpt: This information may include the URL that you just came from... which URL you next go to... your computer browser information, and your IP address... Your IP address is also used to help identify you and to gather broad demographic information.
concerns: IP address used for user identification and profiling
Cross-site URL tracking enables behavioral surveillance
Demographic inference from network activity

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: The app collects device information and uses it along with cookies to target ads and build a profile of your interests. Third-party partners like Google Analytics also receive device-level data.
categories.detail: Device information is collected with consent and used to enhance experience. Cookies and third-party tools like Google Analytics are used for marketing and analytics. Third-party advertising companies may use device and visit information to serve personalized ads.
categories.policy_excerpt: With your consent, we may have access to your ... device information... We use data collection devices such as 'cookies' on certain pages of the Platform to help analyze our web page flow, measure promotional effectiveness... We use cookies from third-party partners such as Google Analytics for marketing and analytical purposes.
concerns: Device info used for ad targeting
Third-party cookies and analytics track users
Advertising companies receive device-level data for personalization

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: If you buy medicines, Flipkart collects your prescription and health information. They may share this with third-party doctors and teleconsultants to validate or reissue your prescription.
categories.detail: The policy states that medical or health-related information may be collected during account setup or transactions. For prescription products, third-party vendors may connect users with medical practitioners or teleconsultants to validate or issue prescriptions based on provided information.
categories.policy_excerpt: We may collect personal data (such as ... medical or health related information) from you when you set up an account or transact with us... we may, through third-party vendors connect You with medical practitioners, teleconsultants or third-party professionals where required to rectify the prescription.
concerns: Health data collected for prescription orders
Shared with third-party medical practitioners and teleconsultants
No specific mention of HIPAA or equivalent health data safeguards

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: Flipkart stores your card details and UPI ID to process orders. They also use this financial information to check if you qualify for loans and credit products from their lending partners.
categories.detail: Payment instrument details including credit/debit cards and UPI ID are collected during transactions. This financial data is also used to check eligibility for insurance, credit, and payment products offered by affiliates and lending partners. Data may be shared with credit bureaus for underwriting.
categories.policy_excerpt: We may collect personal data (such as ... credit card/debit card and other payment instrument details) from you when you set up an account or transact with us... we may also request you to provide your PAN, credit information report... to: (i) check your eligibility for certain products and services like insurance, credit and payment products.
concerns: Financial data stored and used for credit profiling
Shared with lending partners and credit bureaus
UPI ID collected for Flipkart's own payment platform
No explicit mention of tokenization or limited card storage

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: You can update or delete some of your profile information through the app settings. However, Flipkart keeps certain data for fraud prevention and legal reasons, and withdrawing consent may lock you out of services.
categories.detail: Users can access, correct, and update personal data through platform functionalities. Certain non-mandatory information can be deleted via Profile and Settings. Users can withdraw consent by writing to the grievance officer, but this is not retroactive and may restrict platform access. Data is retained for fraud prevention, legal rights, and legal claims, and may be kept in anonymized form for research.
categories.policy_excerpt: You may access, correct, and update your personal data directly through the functionalities provided on the Platform. You may delete certain non-mandatory information by logging into our website and visiting Profile and Settings sections... we may retain data related to you if we believe it may be necessary to prevent fraud or future abuse, to enable Flipkart to exercise its legal rights and/or defend against legal claims.
concerns: Only 'certain non-mandatory' information can be self-deleted
Withdrawal of consent may block platform access
Data retained indefinitely for fraud and legal purposes
No explicit right to full data export

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: Flipkart may change its privacy policy at any time. They say they will alert you to big changes by posting a notice or sending an email if required by law, but you have to check the policy yourself to stay updated.
categories.detail: The policy states users should check it periodically for changes. Significant changes will be alerted by posting the update date, placing a notice on the platform, or sending an email when required by law. There is no requirement for users to actively re-agree.
categories.policy_excerpt: Please check our Privacy Policy periodically for changes... We will alert you to significant changes by posting the date our policy got last updated, placing a notice on our Platform, or by sending you an email when we are required to do so by applicable law.
concerns: No proactive email guarantee for all changes
No requirement for active user re-consent
Continued use likely constitutes acceptance of changes
